text.en:
If your Army Faction is **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM**, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this publication as normal.

If your Army Faction is not **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM**, but every model in your army has the **IMPERIUM** keyword, you can include **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below.

Note that you can include **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT** units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the following to apply:
Eliminate At All Costs

Select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
Acquire At All Costs

Select one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, while an **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** unit from your army is within range of that objective marker, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1 and models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Ranged weapons equipped by **ADEPTUS ARBITES**, **INQUISITOR**, **INQUISITORIAL AGENTS** and **ORDO HERETICUS** models from your army have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

Each time an **ADEPTUS ARBITES**, **INQUISITOR**, **INQUISITORIAL AGENTS** or **ORDO HERETICUS** model from your army makes an attack that targets a Chaos unit containing 5 or more models, that attack has the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

**OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** units from your army can use the Overkill, Soulless Horror and Shieldbreaker abilities twice per battle, instead of once per battle (but cannot use such an ability more than once in the same battle round).

When mustering your army, each **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** unit from your army has the relevant Extremis ability shown below, and you must increase the points cost of each of those units by the amount shown. If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.
Extremis Abilities

*The agents of the Callidus Temple are known to utilisevat‐grown doubles to confound their foes.*

**CALLIDUS ASSASSIN** models only. Twice per battle, in your Movement phase, you can select one other friendly **INFANTRY** model that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. The selected model is destroyed (ignoring any rules that are triggered when a model is destroyed) and this model is removed from the battlefield and set up again as close as possible to where that destroyed model was and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. This ability cannot be used more than once in the same battle round.

*This Culexus operative has been outfitted with various grenades tailored to destroy their assigned targets.*

**CULEXUS ASSASSIN** models only. Each time this model is targeted with the Grenades Stratagem, 1 mortal wound is inflicted for each D6 roll of 3+ instead of for each 4+.

*This Eversor agent’s neurons have been surgically spliced to enhance awareness and speed of thought.*

**EVERSOR ASSASSIN** model only. You can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that **stratagem** this phase. If you do:

■ That use is -1 CP.
■ That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

*These projectiles are tipped with miniaturised melta charges that detonate on impact.*

**VINDICARE ASSASSIN** models only. This model’s exitus rifle has the **[ANTI‑MONSTER 4+]** and **[ANTI‑VEHICLE 4+]**  abilities.

At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Mission Tactics listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Mission Tactic is active and its effects apply to all **DEATHWATCH** units from your army. Each Mission Tactic can only be selected once per battle.
Furor Tactics
While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by **DEATHWATCH** units from your army have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.
Malleus Tactics
While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by **DEATHWATCH** units from your army have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.
Purgatus Tactics
While this Mission Tactic is active, each time a **DEATHWATCH** model from your army makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the **[PRECISION]** ability.

Each time an **INQUISITOR**, **INQUISITORIAL AGENTS** or **ORDO MALLEUS** model from your army makes an attack, re‐roll a Hit roll of 1 and, if the target of that attack is a **DAEMON** unit, re‐roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

This ability cannot be used more than once in the same battle round.

  • Trefferwürfe von 1 wiederholt werden.
  • Oder: wenn das Ziel jener Attacken nicht IMPERIUM/CHAOS hat, Trefferwürfe wiederholt werden.

En los ataques de esta unidad puedes:
  • Repetir las tiradas para impactar de 1.

Les attaques de cette unité peuvent :
  • Relancer les jets de touche de 1.
  • Ou : Si la cible de ces attaques n'a pas le mot-clé IMPERIUM/CHAOS, elles peuvent relancer les jets de touche.

Gli attacchi di questa unità possono:
  • Ripetere i tiri per colpire pari a 1.
  • Oppure: Se il bersaglio di quegli attacchi non ha la keyword IMPERIUM/CAOS, ripetere i tiri per colpire.

  • ヒットロールの出目1をリロールできる。

description.ko:
이 유닛의 공격에 다음을 적용합니다.
  • 값이 1인 명중 굴림을 재굴림할 수 있습니다.
  • 또는, 공격 대상으로 지정된 유닛이 제국/카오스 키워드를 보유하지 않는다면, 명중 굴림을 재굴림할 수 있습니다.
description.zh:
该单位的攻击可以：
  • 重掷结果为 1 的命中掷骰。
  • 或：如果那些攻击的目标不拥有帝国/混沌，重掷命中掷骰。

name.ja: キルチーム

description.en: Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different T characteristics, until the attacking models has finished making it's attacks, use the T characteristic of the majority of the models in the unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more T characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value. For the purpose of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Gravis Veteran models take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any Transport their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Gravis keyword.
description.de: Jedes Mal, wenn eine Attacke diese Einheit zum Ziel hat und sie Modelle mit verschiedenen W-Profilwerten enthält, verwende, bis das attackierende Modell seine Attacken abgeschlossen hat, den W-Profilwert der Mehrheit der Modelle in der Einheit, wenn du ermittelst, welches Wurfergebnis nötig ist, damit jene Attacke erfolgreich verwundet. Falls es bei zwei oder mehr W-Profilwerten einen Gleichstand für die Mehrheit gibt, verwende den höchsten Wert. Beim Ermitteln, welche Modelle in dieser Einheit in einen Transporter einsteigen können, nehmen Gravis-Veteran-Modelle den Platz von 2 Modellen ein, können ansonsten aber in jeden Transporter einsteigen, in den ihre Einheit einsteigen kann, auch wenn ähnliche Modelle in anderen Einheiten das Schlüsselwort Gravis haben.
description.es: Siempre que un ataque tenga como blanco a esta unidad, si contiene miniaturas con diferentes atributos de R, y hasta que las miniaturas atacantes hayan terminado sus ataques, usa el atributo de R de la mayoría de miniaturas de la unidad para determinar qué tiradas hieren con éxito. Si hay dos o más atributos de Rempatados por la mayoría, usa el de mayor valor. De cara a determinar qué miniaturas de esta unidad pueden embarcar en un transporte, las miniaturas Veterano Gravis ocupan el espacio de 2, pero pueden embarcar en los mismos transportes que su unidad, aunque miniaturas similares en otras unidades tengan la clave Gravis.
description.fr: Chaque fois qu'une attaque cible cette unité, si elle contient des figurines avec des caractéristiques d'E différentes, jusqu'à ce que les figurines attaquantes aient fini leurs attaques, utilisez la caractéristique d'E de la majorité des figurines de l'unité pour déterminer le jet requis pour que l'attaque blesse. Si plusieurs caractéristiques d'E sont majoritaires à égalité, utilisez la valeur la plus élevée. Pour déterminer quelles figurines de cette unité peuvent embarquer dans un Transport, les figurines de Vétéran Gravis occupent la place de 2 figurines, mais peuvent par ailleurs embarquer dans n'importe quel Transport dans lequel leur unité peut embarquer, même si des figurines similaires d'autres unités ont le mot-clé Gravis.
description.it: Ogni volta che un attacco ha come bersaglio questa unità, se essa include modelli con caratteristiche R differenti, finché il modello attaccante non ha terminato di effettuare i suoi attacchi, quando determini il tiro necessario affinché quell'attacco ferisca con successo usa la caratteristica R della maggioranza dei modelli dell'unità. Se due o più caratteristiche R sono in parità per la maggioranza, usa il valore più alto. Ai fini di determinare quali modelli di questa unità possono imbarcarsi in un Trasporto, i modelli di Veterano Gravis occupano lo spazio di 2 modelli, ma a parte questo possono imbarcarsi in qualsiasi Trasporto in cui possa imbarcarsi la loro unità, anche se modelli simili in altre unità hanno la keyword Gravis.
description.ja: このユニットが攻撃の対象となる際、このユニット内に異なる【耐】を持つ兵がいる場合、その攻撃側の兵が攻撃を終了するまで、ウーンズロールに成功したかを判定するために参照する【耐】は、このユニット内で最も多数である兵が持つ【耐】を使用する。最も多数である【耐】が複数存在する場合、それらの中で最も高い数値を使用すること。 このユニット内のどの兵が兵員輸送に乗車できるかを判定する際、グラヴィス・ベテラン・兵は2体ぶんの輸送枠を使用するが、他のユニット内の同様の兵がグラヴィスのキーワードを有していたとしても、このユニットが乗車可能なあらゆる兵員輸送に乗車できる。
description.ko: 이 유닛이 공격 대상이 될 때마다, 이 유닛에 포함된 여러 모델의 내구 수치가 서로 다르다면, 공격하는 모델이 공격을 종료할 때까지 유닛에서 가장 다수의 모델이 보유한 내구 수치를 사용해 타격 성공 여부를 판정합니다. 가장 다수인 내구 수치가 둘 이상이라면, 그중 가장 높은 내구 수치를 사용합니다. 수송 모델에 탑승할 수 있는 모델을 판정할 때, 그라비스 베테랑 모델은 모델 2개분의 공간을 차지합니다. 하지만 그 외에는, 이 유닛이 탑승할 수 있는 어떠한 수송 모델에도 탑승할 수 있으며, 이는 다른 유닛에 속한 비슷한 모델이 그라비스 키워드를 가지고 있더라도 마찬가지입니다.
description.zh: 每当该单位成为一次攻击的目标时，如果该单位中包含的模型拥有不同的 T 属性，那么直到攻击模型完成攻击前，使用单位中数量最多的模型的 T 属性来判断那次攻击成功致伤所需要的掷骰结果。如果有两个或更多种模型的数量同样最多，那么使用其中最高的 T 属性数值。 在判断一个单位中哪些模型可以搭乘某个运输工具时，重装型老兵模型占据 2 个模型的空间，但能够搭乘任何其所属单位能够搭乘的运输工具，与其他单位中拥有重装型关键词的相似模型区分。

description.en:
• At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit is **engaged**, this unit can make a **fall-back move** of up to D6".
• At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is more than 3" from all enemy units, you can use this ability. If you do:
• Place this unit in **strategic reserves**.
• This unit must make an **ingress move** in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12” of this model with a **stratagem**, this model can use this ability. If you do increase the CP cost of that use of that **stratagem** by 1CP.

This model cannot be selected to be your **WARLORD**.

If your army faction is **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM**, then during the Declare Battle Formations step, you can replace this model with a different **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** model, provided the total points value of the new model does not exceed the points value of the model it replaced. Your army cannot include duplicates of the same model (i.e. after replacing a model with this rule, your army cannot have more than 1 **VINDICARE Assassin**, it cannot have more than 1 **CULEXUS ASSASSIN**, it cannot have more than 1 **EVERSOR ASSASSIN** and it cannot have more than 1 **CALLIDUS ASSASSIN**).

description.en: Each time you select a **Psyker** unit as the target for this weapon, until those attacks are resolved, change the Attacks characteristic of this weapon to 6.

In your Movement phase, when this model is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can perform an etheric emergence. If it does, this model can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
This model has the Feel No Pain 2+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, each enemy unit within 9" of this model must take a Battle‐shock test, subtracting 1 from that test (or subtracting 2 if that unit is a **PSYKER**).

This model cannot be selected to be your **WARLORD**.

If your army faction is **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM**, then during the Declare Battle Formations step, you can replace this model with a different **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** model, provided the total points value of the new model does not exceed the points value of the model it replaced. Your army cannot include duplicates of the same model (i.e. after replacing a model with this rule, your army cannot have more than 1 **VINDICARE Assassin**, it cannot have more than 1 **CULEXUS ASSASSIN**, it cannot have more than 1 **EVERSOR ASSASSIN** and it cannot have more than 1 **CALLIDUS ASSASSIN**).

fluff.en: Rogue Traders are daring explorers, ruthless conquerors and cunning merchants, traversing and exploiting the uncharted regions of the galaxy in the name of the Imperium. Some command armadas of voidships, while others have only a small retinue of followers. In either case, they are typically canny commanders and able warriors who wield varied heirloom weapons and are backed up by hand‐picked specialists with an array of unusual abilities ranging from talented Lectro‐Maesters to sinister Death Cult Assassins.

description.en:
This model’s attacks that target a Character unit can:
  • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
description.de:
Für Attacken dieses Modells gegen eine Charaktermodell-Einheit können:
  • Trefferwürfe von 1 wiederholt werden.
  • Verwundungswürfe von 1 wiederholt werden.
description.es:
En los ataques de esta miniatura que tomen como blanco una unidad Personaje se pueden:
  • Repetir las tiradas para impactar de 1.
  • Repetir las tiradas para herir de 1.
description.fr:
Les attaques de cette unité qui ciblent une unité de Personnage peuvent :
  • Relancer les jets de touche de 1.
  • Relancer les jets de blessure de 1.
description.it:
Gli attacchi di questo modello che hanno come bersaglio un'unità Personaggio possono:
  • Ripetere i tiri per colpire pari a 1.
  • Ripetere i tiri per ferire pari a 1.
description.ja:
この兵の攻撃がキャラクター・ユニットを対象としていた場合、以下が可能になる：
  • ヒットロールの出目1をリロールする。
  • ウーンズロールの出目1をリロールする。
description.ko:
이 모델의 공격이 캐릭터 유닛을 대상으로 지정하면, 다음을 적용합니다.
  • 값이 1인 명중 굴림을 재굴림할 수 있습니다.
  • 값이 1인 타격 굴림을 재굴림할 수 있습니다.
description.zh:
该模型对角色单位进行的攻击可以：
  • 重掷结果为 1 的命中掷骰。
  • 重掷结果为 1 的致伤掷骰。

name.ja: 戦略的洞察力

description.en: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one combat doctrine to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.
description.de: Du kannst diese Fähigkeit in deiner Befehlsphase einsetzen. Wenn du dies tust, wähle eine Kampfdoktrin, die für diese Einheit bis zu Beginn deiner nächsten Befehlsphase aktiv ist.
description.es: En tu fase de mando, puedes usar esta habilidad. Si lo haces, elige 1 doctrina de combate, la cual estará activa para esta unidad hasta el inicio de tu siguiente fase de mando.
description.fr: À votre phase de Commandement, vous pouvez utiliser cette aptitude. Dans ce cas, choisissez une doctrine de combat afin qu'elle soit active pour cette unité jusqu'au début de votre prochaine phase de Commandement.
description.it: Puoi usare questa abilità nella tua fase di Comando. Se lo fai, scegli una dottrina di combattimento affinché sia attiva per questa unità fino all'inizio della tua prossima fase di Comando.
description.ja: 自軍側指揮フェイズ中、自軍はこのアビリティを使用できる。その場合、戦闘ドクトリンを1個選択せよ。次の自軍側指揮フェイズ開始時まで、このユニットには選択された戦闘ドクトリンが有効となる。
description.ko: 플레이어의 지휘 페이즈에, 이 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 이 유닛에 다음 지휘 페이즈가 시작될 때까지 활성화될 전투 교리를 하나 선택합니다.
description.zh: 在您的指挥阶段中，您可以使用本技能。如果您这样做，在您的下一个指挥阶段开始前，选择一种战斗条令对该单位生效。

name.ja: あれを狩れ（新規）

description.en:
At the start of the first battle round, select up to one enemy unit to be this unit’s hunted:
  • This unit’s attacks that target this unit’s hunted unit can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Each time this unit’s hunted is destroyed, select up to one enemy unit to be this unit’s hunted.
description.de:
Wähle zu Beginn der ersten Schlachtrunde eine feindliche Einheit als von dieser Einheit gejagt:
  • Für Attacken dieser Einheit gegen die von dieser Einheit gejagte Einheit können Verwundungswürfe von 1 wiederholt werden.
  • Jedes Mal, wenn die von dieser Einheit gejagte Einheit zerstört wird, wähle eine feindliche Einheit als von dieser Einheit gejagt.
description.es:
Al inicio de la primera ronda de batalla, elige hasta 1 unidad enemiga como presa de esta unidad:
  • En los ataques de esta unidad que tomen su presa como blanco se pueden repetir las tiradas para herir de 1.
  • Siempre que la presa de esta unidad es eliminada, elige hasta 1 unidad enemiga como la nueva presa de esta unidad.
description.fr:
Au début du premier round de bataille, vous pouvez choisir une unité ennemie comme étant traquée par cette unité :
  • Les attaques de cette unité qui ciblent son unité traquée peuvent relancer les jets de blessure de 1.
  • Chaque fois que l'unité traquée de cette unité est détruite, choisissez une unité ennemie comme étant traquée par cette unité.
description.it:
All'inizio del primo round di battaglia scegli fino a un'unità nemica affinché sia braccata da questa unità:
  • Gli attacchi di questa unità che hanno come bersaglio l'unità braccata da questa unità possono ripetere i tiri per ferire pari a 1.
  • Ogni volta che l'unità braccata da questa unità viene distrutta, scegli fino a un'unità nemica affinché sia braccata da questa unità.
description.ja:
第1バトルラウンド開始時、このユニットの狩猟対象として敵ユニットを最大1個まで選択する：
  • このユニットの攻撃が、このユニットの攻撃が狩猟対象を対象としている場合、ウーンズロールの出目1をリロールしてもよい。
  • このユニットの狩猟対象が撃破された時、このユニットの新たな狩猟対象として敵ユニットを1個選択する。
description.ko:
첫 번째 전투 라운드 시작 시, 적 유닛 최대 하나를 이 유닛의 사냥 대상으로 지정할 수 있습니다.
  • 이 유닛의 공격이 이 유닛의 사냥 대상을 대상으로 지정하면, 그 공격은 값이 1인 타격 굴림을 재굴림할 수 있습니다.
  • 이 유닛의 사냥 대상이 파괴되면 적 유닛 하나를 이 유닛의 사냥 대상으로 지정합니다.
description.zh:
在第一战斗轮次开始时，选择最多一个敌方单位来作为该单位的猎杀对象：
  • 该单位对其猎杀对象单位进行的攻击可以重掷结果为 1 的致伤掷骰。
  • 每当该单位的猎杀对象被摧毁时，选择最多一个敌方单位来作为该单位的猎杀对象。
